$comment: Rule set selection is deterministic: `match` is an extended regex (grep -E)
tested against the newline-separated list of changed paths. `always` loads
unconditionally. Overlap is expected and fine — a .ts file under services/
legitimately pulls in both the backend and frontend sets.
Rule IDs must stay stable across versions: never renumber an existing rule.
Retire a rule by deleting it and leaving its number unused.
